If the gNB-DU detects failure of the MBS shared F1-U link of an MBS Broadcast session it may send the F1AP Broadcast Transport resource request message to the gNB-CU CP including a new DL F1-U transport address. The gNB CU CP should understand that the existing F1-U link has been implicitly released by the gNB-DU. It should release the current UL transport address in the CU UP and get a new one, then trigger the F1AP modification procedure to deliver the new CU UP address to the gNB-DU.

Add following description in clause 8.9.17 for IAB-node authorization:
In case the IAB-node connects to EPS via EN-DC in NSA, the IAB-donor may indicate to the eNB serving the IAB-MT that no UE or descendant node is served by the IAB-node anymore, and removing of the F1 interface and backhaul resources for the unauthorized IAB-node via a SGNB MODIFICATION REQUIRED or SGNB RELEASE REQUIRED message, then the eNB may indicate to the EPC that the IAB-MT can be deregistered.
In case the IAB-node connects with single IAB-donor using NR-DC in SA and the IAB-donor is the SN, the SN may send an indication to the MN that no UE or descendant node is served by the IAB-node anymore, removing the F1 interface and backhaul resources of the unauthorized IAB-node via a S-NODE MODIFICATION REQUIRED or S-NODE RELEASE REQUIRED message, then the MN may indicate to the AMF that the IAB-MT can be deregistered.
In other cases, the RAN-node serving the IAB-MT may send an indication to the 5GC indicating that the IAB-MT can be deregistered after it knows the F1-terminating donor-CU releasing the F1 interface to the unauthorized IAB-node.
